Definition
[Action of a vector field on a function] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0293 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

If $X\in C^\infty (T\mathcal M^n)$ and $f:\mathcal M^n\to \mathbb R$ is differentiable, then $X$ acts on $f$ by differentiation, with local expression \[ X(f)=X^i\frac{\partial f}{\partial x^i}. \]
